messages:
Aria K: Quick capture from this morning's call with PioneerHealth — raw notes for CS->Product triage. Pls flag renewal/onboarding risk.

Ben S: paste them here pls. any immediate churn language?

Aria K: Notes (grouped):
- Index freshness: after a 12k document sync, new clinical guidelines did not appear in search for ~7 hours. Customer quote: "We had to postpone our clinical rollout demo because the new protocols weren't searchable."
- Relevance drift: some queries return internal training docs above live clinical SOPs; they think routing is picking an older model variant.
- Billing controls: they want per-project soft caps + automated emailed notice and a webhook to their SRE pager before overages.
- Onboarding UX: the document-mapper step has unclear dropdown defaults; non-technical users are skipping mapping fields which breaks downstream extraction.
- Bulk upload reliability: bulk sync reported intermittent 504s and ~0.5% of items failed with no retry.

Lena M: Routing suggestion: freshness -> infra/serving; relevance drift -> product-ml + evals; billing controls -> pricing & CS; UX -> product-ux; bulk reliability -> eng-runtime.

Priya: Prioritization note: label freshness and relevance as P0 for PioneerHealth (demo+pilot at risk). Billing controls and UX are P1. Bulk retries P2.

Aria K: Customer language: "If indexing stays flaky we will slow our rollout and re-evaluate alternatives." Marking account health: onboarding_at_risk, renewal_watch.

ops-bot: Created CS-5386: PioneerHealth indexing freshness + relevance (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-5386)
eng-bot: Created CS-5387: PioneerHealth billing controls request (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-5387)

Ben S: Can infra get ingest traces, KV cache invalidate events, and routing decisions for the window 2026-06-12T09:04:10Z -> 2026-06-12T16:00:00Z? Also need sample failing queries for relevance.

Lena M: Customer provided these timings: upload_start=2026-06-12T09:04:10Z, ingest_done=2026-06-12T09:04:27Z, first visible in queries=2026-06-12T16:13:02Z. They attached a small failing query set; will upload to CS-5386.

Aria K: Log snippet they pasted: 
```
2026-06-12T09:04:10Z upload start job=ph_sync_12k user=ph_admin
2026-06-12T09:04:27Z ingest complete job=ph_sync_12k shards=10
2026-06-12T09:04:28Z kv-cache-invalidate queued key=idx/pioneer/12k
2026-06-12T09:04:28Z route->variant select variant=v1 delay=12ms
2026-06-12T09:04:29Z write->index queue=write-buffer delayed
2026-06-12T09:05:02Z 504 upstream timeout id=task_a7
2026-06-12T16:13:02Z query id=q_44 returned=8
```

Priya: Suggest we add a temporary monitoring eval in Redwood Optimize that alerts if bulk import docs are not queryable within 30 minutes. If infra confirms KV invalidation lag we can add a hotfix.

Ben S: Action items:
- Ben -> upload failing queries + CSV to CS-5386 (today EOD)
- Lena -> ping infra for ingest traces & routing map (tomorrow AM)
- Priya -> add prioritization row for Friday product sync (renewal_risk=3, demo_impact=2, engineering_effort=2)
- Aria -> ack customer and set expectation for next update (I've drafted a 24hr triage note).

Lena M: Also adding UX ask: show per-batch indexing status with explicit "searchable" flag and CTA to re-run indexing. I'll route to ux-squad.

Aria K: Customer follow-up quote: "We need confidence this won't happen again before our internal go/no-go next month." Marked playbook: escalate renewal probability.

Priya: I'll prep the scoring matrix and drop into the product sync deck.

Ben S: I'll drop logs + curl repro into CS-5386 and ping when done. :thumbsup:

Aria K: Thanks team — I'll update the PioneerHealth playbook and link tickets to the renewal plan.
